answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 120 Country: India Title: Zakat on Islamic Bank Deposits: Principal, Profit, or Both? Question: I would be grateful if you are able to answer the question below: I would like to know if I were to put $10,000 into an Islamic bank that they invest and pay you any profit earned on the investment (Similar to what the HSBC or Bank Islam do in Malaysia). Would I be liable to pay Zakat on this $10,000 or only on the profit that I would make at the end of the month or year and given to me by the bank if I left the $10,000 in the account. Answer ID: 120 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 373/M=374/M) If you invest $10,000 in any bank as Muzarabah (bank working with your capital and the profit/loss are shared by both) then the profit of the investment is Halah for you and you have to pay zakah on both; capital and profit. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
